_about: Assessed diagnostics that do not block scripts/release.py. Each entry records origin, reason, residual risk, follow-up and evidence; see docs/RELEASE_RUNBOOK.md. Unlisted warnings and failures block publication.

warnings.match: linker stderr: ignoring deprecated linker optimization setting
warnings.origin: Zig linker during the four Linux cross-builds on macOS
warnings.reason: Rust passes its default ELF link optimization argument, which Zig reports as deprecated; not an owned-code diagnostic (https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/158192)
warnings.risk: None observed: cross-linking and wheel integrity pass. Execution on musl and aarch64 is not covered
warnings.follow_up: Adopt the upstream Rust/Zig fix; execute musl and aarch64 wheels on native hosts

warnings.origin: Cargo summary line for the Zig linker diagnostic above
warnings.reason: Counts exactly the assessed linker warning; a higher count matches nothing here and blocks
warnings.follow_up: Remove together with the linker entry

warnings.origin: cc-rs compiler-family probe in the musl cross-builds
warnings.reason: No conventional musl GCC is installed; the build links through Zig (https://github.com/rust-cross/cargo-zigbuild) and produces both wheels
warnings.risk: A future C dependency would need an explicit target compiler
warnings.follow_up: Configure the target C compiler explicitly when maintaining the cross-builder; run the wheels on musl hosts
